evidence.title: E2S-Pruner: Progressive Two-Stage Evidence Fusion for Visual Token Pruning in Vision-Language Models

summary: Researchers introduce E2S-Pruner, a two-stage evidence fusion technique for visual token pruning, improving the efficiency of vision-language models without sacrificing performance. The method progressively refines token selection to optimize computational resources.
title: New AI Method E2S-Pruner Enhances Efficiency in Vision-Language Models Through Progressive Token Pruning
